text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It must have been etched into the very souls of the crowd!!
That momentary brilliance!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...That very moment is my raison d'être.
The very value that makes me who I am."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I've said too much.
The aftertaste of victory is simply too delicious.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes... pure delight.
I can easily picture the staggered steps of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much time passes,
the strength I proved today will never fade.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pure bliss...!!
Tonight, let us revel without restraint!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Asking for seconds already, are we...? Heheh.
What utter gluttony."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And... ah, indeed! Me too!
I can still get intoxicated! Deeper into the abyss!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Strip away all weakness!!
I shall flaunt my dazzling radiance!!!!
